title: 한눈에 ②: 양보·가정 연결 구별하기
objective: By the end, you can choose between -아도/어도, -더라도, -(으)ㄹ지라도, -고도, -거니와 and -(ㄴ/는)다면 and attach each one correctly to verbs and adjectives.
summary: This page compares six Korean connectors for "even if," "despite," "besides," and "if," and shows how strong or formal each one is.

task.title: Choose, fill in, judge
task.line: Use the table on page 1 to pick or build the right connector for each sentence.

forms.when: Verbs and adjectives, in speech and writing. Works for real facts and for guesses. Often used with 아무리.
forms.means: even if / even though. Basic strength (1 of 3).
forms.exampleMeaning: No matter how busy I am, I always eat breakfast.

forms.when: Verbs and adjectives. Mostly for a case you are only imagining or assuming.
forms.means: even if (it turns out that) ... Stronger than -아도 (2 of 3).
forms.exampleMeaning: Even if the exam turns out to be hard, don't give up.

forms.when: Verbs and adjectives. Formal: speeches, writing, serious promises.
forms.means: even if (in the worst case) ... The strongest (3 of 3).
forms.exampleMeaning: Even if the result is not good, I will do my best.

forms.when: Can attach to verbs and adjectives, but the "despite" meaning is mainly used with verbs. The first action is already done.
forms.means: despite having done ... (the expected result did not follow).
forms.example: 그 사람은 제 이야기를 듣고도 아무 말도 안 했어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: He heard what I said, but still didn't say a word.

forms.when: Verbs and adjectives, often with 도 ... 도. A little formal.
forms.means: not only ... but also. It adds a second point. It does NOT mean "even if."
forms.example: 이 식당은 음식도 맛있거니와 직원들도 친절해요.
forms.exampleMeaning: Not only is the food at this restaurant good, the staff are friendly too.

forms.when: Verbs: -ㄴ다면 after a vowel, -는다면 after a consonant; ㄹ-stem verbs drop ㄹ and take -ㄴ다면 (살다 → 산다면). Adjectives: -다면. Past: -았/었다면.
forms.means: if (supposing that) ... Less likely or more imagined than -(으)면.
forms.example: 복권에 당첨된다면 세계 여행을 하고 싶어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: If I won the lottery, I'd like to travel around the world.

watchOut: 비싸고도 샀어요 (X) → 비싸도 샀어요 (O): -고도 meaning "despite" is mainly used with verbs, for an action already done. After an adjective it just means "and also," which does not fit this sentence.
먹다면 (X) → 먹는다면 (O): verbs take -ㄴ/는다면. Adjectives take only -다면 (좋다면).
비가 오거니와 갈 거예요 (X) → 비가 와도 갈 거예요 (O): -거니와 adds a point. It never means "even if."
비쌀지라도 사 줄게 (too stiff) → 비싸도 사 줄게 (natural): The first sentence is not a grammar error. -(으)ㄹ지라도 is for speeches and writing, so with friends it sounds too stiff.
exercises: Choose the right form: ① 그는 사실을 알(고도 / 거니와) 아무에게도 말하지 않았어요. ② 이 노트북은 가볍(거니와 / 고도) 배터리도 오래가요. ③ 돈이 많(다면 / 더라도) 큰 집을 사고 싶어요.
Fill in the blank with -아도/어도 (use 춥다): 날씨가 ____ 매일 아침 산책을 해요.
Fill in the blank with -더라도 (use 힘들다): 일이 좀 ____ 끝까지 해 봅시다.
This sentence is for a formal speech. Rewrite 반대해도 with -(으)ㄹ지라도: 모든 사람이 반대해도 이 계획을 계속하겠습니다.
Fill in the blanks with -(ㄴ/는)다면: ① 매일 운동을 ____ (하다) 건강해질 거예요. ② 집이 회사에서 ____ (가깝다) 좋겠어요. ③ 그 사람이 진심으로 ____ (사과하다) 용서할게요.
Write O if the sentence is natural and X if it is not: ① 시간이 없거니와 가 볼게요. ② 친구가 도와준다면 금방 끝낼 수 있어요. ③ 그 사람은 약속을 잊고도 사과하지 않았어요.
answers: ① 알고도 ② 가볍거니와 ③ 많다면
모든 사람이 반대할지라도 이 계획을 계속하겠습니다.
① 한다면 ② 가깝다면 ③ 사과한다면
① X (시간이 없어도 가 볼게요 / 없더라도 가 볼게요) ② O ③ O
